hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r c; if echo "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]|\s)git\s+stash(\s|$)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git stash is blocked in this repo: refs/stash is shared across git worktrees sharing one .git dir, and this chain has hit stash-collision risk multiple times.
